retrievalProfile.description: A desaturated, high-key portrait of three figures with a prominent lavender-colored, curly display script at the top.
excludeWhen: modern minimalist sans-serif typography is needed

recipe.visualDefinition: A desaturated, almost monochromatic photograph of three women in a staggered, overlapping composition, topped with a large, stylized lavender script featuring exaggerated curls and drop shadows.
coreVisualRelationships: High-key desaturation against a white background
Contrast between organic hair textures and sharp typographic curls
Lavender accent color against a neutral grayscale palette
coreInvariants: Lavender-purple color for the primary display text
Exaggerated spiral terminals on the lettering

compositionAndHierarchy.subjectPositionAndScale: Three subjects arranged in a diagonal line from bottom-left to center-right, occupying the lower two-thirds of the frame.
compositionAndHierarchy.visualAnchor: The large, stylized lavender text at the top center.
compositionAndHierarchy.movementAndEyePath: Starts at the vibrant text, moves down through the faces of the three subjects following the diagonal line of their heads.
compositionAndHierarchy.negativeSpace: Significant white space at the top and sides to isolate the subjects and text.

colorSystem.dominantColorRole: Desaturated grayscale/off-white for the photographic elements.
colorSystem.contrastColorRole: Deep charcoal for clothing and shadows.
colorSystem.accentColorRole: Muted lavender (#A68AC9) for the display typography.
colorSystem.saturationAndValueRelationship: Low saturation across the image with a single pop of medium-value purple.

typographyAndGraphicLanguage.baseSkeleton: Whimsical, upright script with high-waisted proportions.
letterConstructionRules: Exaggerated spiral curls on ascenders and descenders
Variable stroke width with thick verticals and thin connectors
Sharp, pointed terminals on non-curled strokes
Tight letter spacing with slight overlaps
characterSpecificRedesigns: Uppercase 'W' with a large inward spiral on the first stroke
Lowercase 'd' with a tall, spiraling ascender
Lowercase 'i' with a circular dot integrated into the stem's curl
typographyAndGraphicLanguage.pairingStrategy: Stand-alone decorative script; if body text is needed, use a clean, light-weight sans-serif.

candidateDirections.reason: Matches the curly, whimsical nature of the terminals.
Captures the organic, flowing lines and decorative flourishes.

twoStageComposition.backgroundInstruction: Generate a high-key, desaturated photograph of three women in a staggered diagonal line against a white background, using soft focus and 90s-style hair and makeup.
twoStageComposition.overlayInstruction: Add custom lavender-colored script lettering at the top center with exaggerated spiral curls and a subtle dark purple drop shadow.

verificationChecks: Are there spiral curls on the letters?
Is the photo desaturated and high-key?
Are there three subjects in a staggered layout?

mustRedesign: Any modern digital filters that look too sharp
Standard system fonts like Arial or Times New Roman
postGenerationChecks: Check that the lavender text is legible despite the curls.
Ensure the desaturation doesn't lose all facial detail.
Verify the drop shadow on the text is subtle and not distracting.
Confirm the composition follows a diagonal flow.
recipe.reuseFormula: Desaturated Trio Portrait + Lavender Curly Script Header = 90s Pop Aesthetic
